The Phoenix Theatre

Welcome to the Phoenix Theatre situated in London’s world famous theatre district, the West End.

BOOK YOUR TICKETS

Stranger Things: The First Shadow

Fri 17 Nov 2023 - Sun 27 Dec 2026

Stranger Things: The First Shadow

Show Info

For over 90 years, the Phoenix has played host to the very best of live theatre featuring productions from the giants of the stage such as Noël Coward and Stephen Sondheim.

Recently it has seen critically acclaimed shows Come From Away and Noises Off, with Tennessee Williams’ masterpiece, A Streetcar Named Desire to follow for a limited season. Grade II listed, featuring a distinctive Italian style interior the Phoenix promises a classic theatre experience that you’ll never forget. Book your tickets from the official site of the theatre.

Ticket Information
London’s West End

Phoenix Theatre Tickets

Find all the relevant ticket information for show’s at the Phoenix Theatre in London’s West End from the official box office of the theatre. Read on for details about ticket prices, availability, group bookings and more.

Where can I purchase tickets for shows at the Phoenix Theatre from?

Tickets to shows at the Phoenix Theatre can be purchased online from ATG Tickets or alternatively in person from the box office at the theatre.

What is currently playing at the Phoenix Theatre?

The current show is Stranger Things: The First Shadow. Brought to life by a multi-award-winning creative team, Stranger Things: The First Shadow is set within the mythology and world of Netflix's hugely popular series.
You can view the full list of shows at the theatre via our What’s On page

Are there limits to the number of tickets that can be purchased in one transaction?

You may purchase tickets for up to nine guests per transaction. For groups of 10+, please contact our groups booking team

When will I receive my tickets?

Your tickets will be sent via email to the lead booker for the show. Please note that this is separate to your order confirmation email. Typically tickets are emailed immediately but please do allow 48 hours for it to arrive.

One Voucher. A world of possibilities.

Treat them to an unforgettable experience with an ATG Gift Voucher. Packed full of possibilities, each digital gift voucher is a pass to some of the best theatre and live entertainment, in our 37 venues across the UK. With hundreds of incredible musicals, plays, concerts and comedy shows to choose from, the lucky recipient is sure to find something they will truly enjoy.
